sections.content_text: Section 81 - Income of Approved Tax Holiday Subject to the provisions of this Act, income included in the head “Income from Business” earned by any authorized tax exempted entity shall be subject to the limits, conditions and qualifications prescribed for certain periods in part-4 of the Sixth Schedule under this chapter fully or partly tax exemption will be availed. (2) Any benefit of income-tax exemption received under sub-section (1) shall not be included in the total income of the taxpayer, but shall be shown in the relevant part of the return. (3) An approved tax exempted entity shall be granted tax exemption under sub-section (1) subject to the following conditions, namely:- (a) the entity is owned and managed by such person, who— (i) any statutory body established by or under law having its head office in Bangladesh; (ii) such company as defined in the Companies Act, 1994 (Act No. 18 of 1994) and having its registered office in Bangladesh has a purchased or paid-up capital of not less than Tk. 20 (twenty) lakhs on the date of commencement of commercial production; (b) the entity has not been formed by way of separation or reorganization or re-incorporation from any such business already in existence; (c) any factory, machinery, equipment or any other important immovable property if not previously used by any other entity in Bangladesh; (d) the said entity— (i) has received the TIN; (ii) kept accounts in accordance with the provisions of this Act; (iii) Individually and separately maintained accounts. Explanation,— For the purposes of this section, “approved tax exempted entity” means an entity associated with, an income year from Which income is derived from business and which— (a) has been approved by the Board for partial or full tax exemption under this Chapter; (b) has been approved for the said tax exemption or reduction in the relevant income year.
